verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1993.

notes.text:
Reissue Of "The Axeman Cometh" with new cover artwork

The 2017 repress you find here:

Comes with 12" x 12" liner note sheet written by Martin Weaver.

Recorded 1969-1972, this release 2012

On sticker:
First volume of the complete recordings (1968-1972) by this legendary UK underground power trio leaded by Martin Weaver (later member of Dark of "Round The Edges" fame).
Raw, unadulterated psychedelic hard-rock, a real fest of fuzz and wah-wah which will blow the mind of any hard-psych collector. 
Lavish double vinyl edition, includes insert with liner notes by doomy psychedelic guitar god in person, Martin Weaver.
